card.name: Central European place names, historical
card.fires_on: Partway through or just after historical place names in central and eastern Europe, such as Viipuri, Prussia, Trieste, Fiume and Elbing. It also fires on words that bring in an old versus modern name, like 'today'.

modes.label: Inside border-region town names
modes.description: Final pieces of town or region names once under changing rule, such as Viipuri, Trieste, Fiume, Elbing.
modes.example: He was educated at the Classical Lyceum at Viip<<uri>>, Finland.

modes.label: Old name versus modern name
modes.description: Words that introduce the present-day name, such as 'today' in brackets after East Prussia.

card.plain: It lights up on old European place names, especially cities whose country changed, and on words that point to their modern names.
